title: Insulin Pump Program Patient Relations Memo: First-Liability Courtesy in a Charge Review
content:
In the review of a non-covered item charge on an Insulin Pump Program, the supported charge follows the program's **other** non-covered item charges — every non-covered item charge on the program except the one under review:

- where the program carries no other non-covered item charge and none posted in the 6 months before today (the first-liability months), the supported charge is reduced by 10 percent (the first-liability percent);
- where it carries another one but none posted in those 6 months, it is reduced by 5 percent (half the first-liability percent);
- otherwise there is no first-liability courtesy.

A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window.

| Other non-covered item charges on the program | Courtesy |
|---|---|
| none at all | 10 percent |
| one or more, none posted in the 6 months before today | 5 percent |
| at least one posted in the 6 months before today | none |
